customer_message.subject: Bedroom wall – my mother's health
customer_message.body:
Name: Arjun Demir
Address: Schulhausstrasse 5, 4410 Liestal, 3.5 rooms
Landlord: Liegenschaften Sternen AG

Message:
I share the flat with my mother, who is 76. In the bedroom, behind the wardrobe, the wall has turned black and furry, and over the summer this has crept up and along the ceiling; the room smells musty and clothes in the wardrobe smell the same. My mother sleeps in that room and has had one sinus infection after another since spring. Her doctor told her it comes from what is growing on the wall.

Sternen AG's caretaker looked at it and said he would report back. Whether someone qualified now has to come and examine the wall to find out where the moisture comes from has not been decided; the caretaker said he would discuss that with the management.

I am not willing to keep paying full rent like this. I have read about paying the rent into the deposit account at the conciliation office, and if nothing happens by November, I will do that.

What should my next step be?

Arjun Demir
